newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed, little changed.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed, little changed.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed but barely changed from Monday, with cement manufacturer Cementos Diamante one of the few winners among actively traded shares.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index slipped 0.06 percent to end at 13,501.21 on a lower-than-average trading volume of 836.1 million pesos. Bogota's IBB index gained 0.05 percent, meanwhile, closing at 861.21 on a volume of 1.4 billion pesos.
Volume in Bogota was fueled by large cross trades, including one that pushed lightly traded construction firm Ingenieria Construcel up 8.69 percent to 250 pesos per share.
Most stocks involved in the crosses, including insurance giant Latinoamericana de Seguros, ended unchanged, however.
Common shares of blue-chip Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, rose 0.89 percent in Bogota to close at 282.50 a share.
But the day's biggest gainer was Cementos Diamante, which rose 2.19 percent to close at 4,000 pesos a share.

Brokers said foreign funds as well as local investors were betting that the recent acquisition of Diamante by Mexico's Cementos Mexicanos would help it cut costs and boost profitability in the near term.

In Medellin, losers included brewer Bavaria SA, which fell 0.78 percent on profit-taking to close at 3,770 pesos a share and Banco Industrial Colombiano, which dropped 0.41 percent to end at 3,610 pesos per share.
